description: This file implements a singleton class 'ConversationContextProvider' that manages OpenTelemetry tracing contexts and conversation IDs for a chat or conversation system within the Pipecat project. It provides methods to set, get, and generate conversation-specific tracing contexts and IDs, facilitating distributed tracing.

classes.name: ConversationContextProvider
classes.description: Provides singleton access to manage and retrieve the current conversation's tracing context and ID, integrating with OpenTelemetry.

methods.name: get_instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConversationContextProvider.

methods.name: set_current_conversation_context
methods.description: Sets the current conversation's span context and optional conversation ID, creating a non-recording span if span context is provided.

methods.name: get_current_conversation_context
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenTelemetry context for the conversation.

methods.name: generate_conversation_id
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string to be used as a conversation ID.
